'''Bone Fragments''' are special [[:Category:Resources|resources]] that can be dropped by [[Skeleton]]s and [[Lava Lurk]]s when slain, by destroying [[Mining#Bone Node|Bone Nodes]] on [[Ginger Island]], by destroying crates and barrels in [[Skull Cavern]], by [[Pans|Panning]], and in [[Artifact Spot]]s. It can also be gifted by a [[Animals#Pets|pet]] dog with max [[Animals#Friendship|friendship]].

==Bone Mill==
Five Bone Fragments can be turned into [[Quality Fertilizer]], [[Speed-Gro]], [[Deluxe Speed-Gro]], or [[Tree Fertilizer]] in the [[Bone Mill]].

==Trade==
The [[Island Trader]] on [[Ginger Island]] trades, as permanent stock:
*1 [[Taro Tuber]] for 2 Bone Fragments
*The [[Banana Pudding]] recipe for 30 Bone Fragments

==Tailoring==
Bone Fragment is used in the spool of the [[2 Willow Lane#Sewing Machine|Sewing Machine]] to create the [[Tailoring|Skeleton Shirt]]. [[File:Shirt014.png|24px]] It can be used in [[dyeing]], serving as a yellow dye in the dye pots, located at [[Emily]]'s and [[Haley]]'s house [[2 Willow Lane]].

==Quests==
*[[Quests#Fragments of the past|"Fragments of the past"]]: [[Gunther]] may make a request on the [[Quests#List of Special Orders|Special Orders board]] for 100 Bone Fragments or other bone items that must be gathered while the quest is active. You have 7 days to complete the quest. The reward is {{Price|3500}} and the [[Bone Mill]] recipe.
